name: Congenital Infiltrating Lipomatosis of the Face

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic criteria for Congenital Infiltrating Lipomatosis of the Face

criteria.description: Presence of unilateral, diffuse, infiltrating adipose tissue proliferation in the facial region
Soft tissue hypertrophy of the affected side of the face including muscles and subcutaneous tissues
Lack of encapsulation of the lipomatous tissue on histopathology
Congenital or early infancy onset of facial swelling
Associated bony hypertrophy of the facial skeleton on imaging

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of unilateral infiltrating adipose tissue proliferation with soft tissue hypertrophy and absence of encapsulation confirmed by histopathology
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by imaging and histopathology; genetic testing is not routinely diagnostic.

imaging: MRI showing diffuse, infiltrative, non-encapsulated fatty tissue proliferation
CT scan demonstrating bony hypertrophy of facial bones
Ultrasound showing increased echogenicity of subcutaneous tissues
genetic: No consistent genetic mutation identified; somatic mutations in PIK3CA reported in some cases
other: Histopathology revealing mature adipose tissue infiltrating muscle and connective tissue without capsule

distinguishingFeatures: Asymmetric overgrowth involving multiple tissues including skin, bone, and connective tissue
Presence of cerebriform connective tissue nevi
Localized nerve enlargement with fatty infiltration
Distinct nerve fascicle enlargement on imaging
Enlargement of all tissues on one side of the face including bone, muscle, and skin

redFlags: Rapid progression of facial swelling beyond infancy
Neurological deficits such as facial nerve palsy
Development of compressive symptoms or airway obstruction
references: Alotaibi NM, et al. Congenital infiltrating lipomatosis of the face: a review and case report. J Oral Maxillofac Surg. 2019.
Orphanet: Congenital infiltrating lipomatosis of the face. ORPHA:583097.
Ramesh P, et al. Congenital infiltrating lipomatosis of the face: clinical and radiological features. Indian J Radiol Imaging. 2017.
